change.description: Add process-local managed-task runtime observation, effective schedule metadata, safe schedule reset, and task-operations filters.
change.release_unit_description: Task operations runtime API, maintenance controls, and responsive task workspace.

planned.reasoning: The runtime endpoint and catalog fields are additive, and no persistent schema or default override values are added. Existing unsupported overrides remain readable and explicit reset is backwards-compatible for existing control clients.

scope_drift.description: The implementation remains additive and does not introduce a schema migration.

current.reasoning: The only durable writes are existing managed-task control columns through the established PATCH route; computed catalog metadata and active observations are in-memory or response-only.

verified.reasoning: Focused Rust and Web checks verify additive response metadata, in-memory observation cleanup, and schedule reset semantics. Full release evidence remains a gate before publication.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing clients may continue reading legacy task fields and sending enabled-only PATCH requests; runtime, triggerKinds, policy, and capability fields are additive.

persistent_state.state_description: Existing maintenance task enabled flags, interval/cron overrides, next trigger values, progress, and history.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Existing same-major releases with the maintenance task tables; direct major skips remain unsupported.
